summary: Tested the new 'Save as image' button on the public /summary/:id page. Button is visible with correct data-testid, clicking triggers a valid PNG download with correct filename pattern (courtsplit-<venue-slug>-<date>.png, 161KB), success toast appears, copy-link button still works, and the summary card regression (players, court+shuttle breakdown, collected/outstanding, footer) all render correctly on direct navigation.

issues: html-to-image logs non-fatal SecurityError console warnings when trying to inline the Google Fonts stylesheet (fonts.googleapis.com cssRules blocked by CORS). PNG still generates successfully but web fonts (Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans / JetBrains Mono) may not be embedded and could fall back to system fonts in the exported image. Consider passing fontEmbedCSS option or self-hosting fonts / using skipFonts:true to silence noise.

action_items: Optional: silence html-to-image font-inline warnings on Summary page by passing skipFonts:true or providing a pre-fetched fontEmbedCSS to toPng() to ensure exported PNG uses the app's brand fonts consistently.
critical_code_review_comments: Summary.jsx downloadImage() handles error path with toast.error and re-enables the button in finally — good.
Filename slug logic replaces non-alphanum with dashes and lowercases — safe for filesystems.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Summary Save-as-image feature verified working E2E via Playwright expect_download. Downloaded file: courtsplit-smash-arena-2026-06-01.png (161KB). Only observation is non-fatal html-to-image CORS warnings for Google Fonts stylesheet — cosmetic/console noise, not a functional bug.
